author: c4ooo
body:
As you can see, i am now looking for a team, something i have only now considered after the break up of my last team last summer, and my hiatus from which i came back ~5(?) months ago. I am not the best at pvp, nor the worst :P I try to use the environment to create the best advantage for my self. I am not very good at dealing KB, but as Deliciousshoes knows, i am good with a bow ;) (albeit i have become a bit rusty with it >_> )
Sword PVP:7/10
Bow PVP: 8/10
Preferred position: Midfield / offense (but not rushing (I don't like rushing in normal games because it ruins my KD >_> )) When can i play: any time after 2:40 PM eastern time
Age: high school
 skype: I will message this to you when/if you accept me, i already have too much skype spam from bots >_>
